name: offline-music-player
description: Offline Music Player with Synced Lyrics and Spotify aesthetic

scripts.build:apk: gradle :app:assembleDebug && mkdir -p APK_HERE && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk APK_HERE/OfflineMusic.apk
scripts.build:apk:release: gradle :app:assembleRelease && mkdir -p APK_HERE && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk APK_HERE/OfflineMusic.apk 2>/dev/null || true
